vulnerability_context: The FrankInuToken contract suffers from an owner privilege abuse vulnerability. The owner can unilaterally set the fee-receiving addresses (marketing, developer, treasury) and adjust sell fees to an extreme level. This allows the owner to set a 100% sell tax and redirect all proceeds from user sales to an address of their choice, effectively stealing the full value of the transaction.
winning_reflection: The key insight was to recognize that the forked contract was already live ('tradingActive'), making the initial `launch()` call unnecessary and erroneous. The successful strategy involved directly impersonating the existing owner, leveraging their unrestricted power to set all fee addresses to the attacker's control and raising the sell fee to 100%. This ensured that any subsequent user sale would have its entire value redirected to the attacker.
